review: I like the hazard variety and the readable screens, but the curve is uneven. Saw Mill is a difficulty spike at stage 3: only 37% of mid players pass and my mid run died to a ground saw right at the goal. Ferry Lines is the opposite problem for me: all three skill levels finish in about 12.4 s, so the platforms set the pace and skill saves no time. Spring Loaded has good air routes but little risk. Crumble Bridge, Laser Gate and Gauntlet flow well, though the high-skill death to a Gauntlet laser and the 25 s Spike Garden run look like timing traps, not execution tests.
best: Crumble Bridge and Gauntlet reward continuous movement and mix hazards without stopping the run.
worst: Ferry Lines locks every player to the same 12.4 s cycle, and Saw Mill spikes the difficulty too early.
